description: This file defines the interface AdministrationService in the OpenMRS project, which contains methods related to administrative tasks such as managing global properties, system information, implementation ID, locales, and database operations.

classes.name: AdministrationService
classes.description: Interface for administrative operations in OpenMRS, including managing global properties, system info, implementation IDs, locales, executing SQL, and serialization whitelists.

methods.name: setAdministrationDAO
methods.description: Sets the DAO implementation for database access.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a global property by its UUID.

methods.name: getSystemVariables
methods.description: Returns a sorted map of important system variables.

methods.name: getSystemInformation
methods.description: Returns a map of system information including Java version, user info, runtime properties, etc.

methods.name: getGlobalProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a global property by name.

methods.name: getGlobalProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a global property by name, with a default value fallback.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyObject
methods.description: Gets the GlobalProperty object matching the given property name.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertiesByPrefix
methods.description: Returns global properties starting with a specified prefix.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertiesBySuffix
methods.description: Returns global properties ending with a specified suffix.

methods.name: getAllGlobalProperties
methods.description: Fetches all global properties.

methods.name: saveGlobalProperties
methods.description: Saves a list of global properties to the database.

methods.name: purgeGlobalProperty
methods.description: Deletes a specified global property.

methods.name: purgeGlobalProperties
methods.description: Deletes a list of global properties.

methods.name: setGlobalProperty
methods.description: Creates or updates a global property with specified name and value.

methods.name: updateGlobalProperty
methods.description: Overwrites an existing global property; fails if property does not exist.

methods.name: saveGlobalProperty
methods.description: Saves (creates or updates) a specific global property object.

methods.name: addGlobalPropertyListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for global property changes.

methods.name: removeGlobalPropertyListener
methods.description: Removes a registered global property listener.

methods.name: executeSQL
methods.description: Executes SQL statements on the database, with an option to restrict to SELECT statements.

methods.name: getImplementationId
methods.description: Fetches the server's implementation ID.

methods.name: setImplementationId
methods.description: Sets the server's implementation ID.

methods.name: getAllowedLocales
methods.description: Returns locales permitted for use in the system.

methods.name: getPresentationLocales
methods.description: Returns locales for UI presentation based on allowed locales.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyValue
methods.description: Generic method to retrieve global property value with specified type and default.

methods.name: getMaximumPropertyLength
methods.description: Returns maximum length constraints for object fields.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of objects to prevent premature flushes.

methods.name: getSearchLocales
methods.description: Returns sorted locales for search, considering user preferences and allowed locales.

methods.name: setImplementationIdHttpClient
methods.description: Sets the HTTP client for accessing implementation services.

methods.name: isDatabaseStringComparisonCaseSensitive
methods.description: Indicates whether database string comparison is case-sensitive.

methods.name: updatePostgresSequence
methods.description: Updates sequence values in PostgreSQL to align with insertions.

methods.name: getSerializerWhitelistTypes
methods.description: Returns list of classes or packages whitelisted for deserialization for security.
